assertions.description: The user is on the home page.
The link to the product catalogue is visible.
After clicking the catalogue link, the user is on the catalogue page.
A list of products is displayed.

acceptance_tests.description: Verify that a customer can navigate to and browse the product catalogue.
acceptance_tests.name: Customer Browses Catalogue

assertions.description: The user is on the catalogue page.
Stock availability is indicated for products in the catalogue list.
The user navigates to a product detail page.
Detailed stock status is visible on the product detail page.

acceptance_tests.description: Verify that a customer can view the stock status of products.
acceptance_tests.name: Customer Checks Stock Status

assertions.description: The user is on the home page.
The link to the tool hire section is visible.
After clicking the hire link, the user is on the tool hire page.
A list of hire items is displayed.
The user navigates to the hire booking page for a specific item.
The hire date selection calendar is visible.

acceptance_tests.description: Verify that a customer can successfully reserve a tool for hire.
acceptance_tests.name: Customer Reserves Hire Item

capabilities.description: Allows customers to navigate and view the available product lines and individual items.
capabilities.name: Browse Product Catalogue

capabilities.description: Enables customers to see the current availability of products.
capabilities.name: Check Stock Status

capabilities.description: Provides a mechanism for customers to book and reserve tools for hire.
capabilities.name: Reserve Hire Items

evidence.description: A visible link or button to navigate to the product catalogue.
evidence.name: Catalogue Link on Home Page

evidence.description: A visible link or button to navigate to the tool hire section.
evidence.name: Tool Hire Link on Home Page

evidence.description: A list or grid of products from the catalogue, showing at least 16 lines.
evidence.name: Product List Display

evidence.description: Interactive elements allowing customers to filter the product catalogue.
evidence.name: Catalogue Filtering Options

evidence.description: An indicator on each product listing showing its stock availability.
evidence.name: Product Stock Status in Catalogue

evidence.description: The name of the product is clearly displayed.
evidence.name: Product Name Display

evidence.description: Specific stock availability information for the selected product.
evidence.name: Detailed Product Stock Status

evidence.description: A browsable list of tools available for hire.
evidence.name: List of Hire Items

evidence.description: An indicator showing if a hire item is currently available or booked.
evidence.name: Hire Item Availability Indicator

evidence.description: An interactive calendar for selecting start and end dates for hire.
evidence.name: Hire Date Selection Calendar

evidence.description: A summary of the selected hire item, dates, and cost before confirmation.
evidence.name: Hire Reservation Summary

evidence.description: A message confirming the successful reservation of a hire item.
evidence.name: Hire Confirmation Message

pages.purpose: Display all available product lines and items for browsing.

pages.purpose: Show detailed information for a specific product, including stock status.

product_intent.desired_outcome: A practical site where the catalogue is browsable and hire is bookable.
product_intent.name: Copperline Hardware Digital Hub
product_intent.problem: Showing a deep catalogue and taking tool-hire reservations.
success_metrics: Number of tool-hire reservations made online
Customer satisfaction with browsing and booking experience
product_intent.summary: A digital platform for Copperline Hardware to showcase its deep product catalog and facilitate tool-hire reservations, serving homeowners, tradespeople, and gardeners.

requirements.description: The system must display a comprehensive product catalogue with at least sixteen tool and garden lines.
requirements.title: Display Deep Product Catalogue

requirements.description: Customers must be able to browse the product catalogue.
requirements.title: Allow Catalogue Browsing

requirements.description: Customers must be able to check what items are in stock.
requirements.title: Display Stock Availability

requirements.description: Customers must be able to reserve hire items.
requirements.title: Enable Tool-Hire Reservations

requirements.description: The system must support the operations of a tool-hire counter.
requirements.title: Tool-Hire Counter Functionality

roles.description: A homeowner, tradesperson, or allotment gardener looking to browse products or reserve hire items.
goals: Find specific tools or garden items
roles.name: Customer
